# 1 Clement Chapter 56 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 56 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_056_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 56

**56:1** Therefore let us also make intercession for those who have fallen into any transgression, that meekness and humility may be granted to them, so that they may yield not to us but to the will of God. For in this way there shall be for them a fruitful and perfect commemoration with compassion before God and the saints.

**56:2** Let us accept correction, at which no one ought to be annoyed, beloved. The admonition which we give one to another is good and exceedingly profitable, for it joins us to the will of God.

**56:3** For thus the holy word says: "The LORD has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

**56:4** For whom the LORD loves he chastens, and he scourges every son whom he receives."

**56:5** "For the righteous man will chasten me in mercy and will reprove me; but let not the oil of the sinner anoint my head."

**56:6** And again it says: "Blessed is the man whom the LORD reproves, and reject not the discipline of the Almighty. For he causes pain and then restores again;

**56:7** he smites, and his hands heal.

**56:8** Six times he will deliver you from distress, and at the seventh time no evil shall touch you.

**56:9** In famine he will rescue you from death; and in war he will redeem you from the power of the sword.

**56:10** And from the lash of the tongue he will hide you, and you shall not fear when evil approaches.

**56:11** You shall laugh at the unjust and the lawless, and of wild beasts you shall not be afraid.

**56:12** For wild beasts shall be at peace with you.

**56:13** Then you shall know that your house shall be at peace, and the dwelling of your tent shall not fail.

**56:14** And you shall know that your seed shall be many, and your children shall be like the herbs of the field.

**56:15** And you shall enter the tomb like ripe grain harvested in its season, or like a heap of the threshing floor gathered at the right time."

**56:16** You see, beloved, how great is the protection given to those who are disciplined by the Master; for being a good father he instructs us that we may receive mercy through his holy discipline.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
